values.value: Source article language code: {LANG}. IMPORTANT: write EVERY rewritten field value in the source article's language ({LANG}). Do NOT translate the content into English or any other language — all prose, titles, headings, and list items must be in the source language. Keep English brand names, product names, and acronyms (VPN, MFA, SCIM, EDR, etc.) as-is, but write ALL surrounding prose in the source language. The presence of English terms in the source does NOT make the article English.
